content: Use JetStream for all durable event publishing — never core NATS for stream-captured subjects
SurrealDB uses HNSW for vector search with cosine distance — index name is entity_embedding_hnsw
Memory ingester stalls when ROSETTA_URL is unreachable — falls back to no-embedding upsert after 30s timeout
To reset the ingest cursor and force full re-ingestion, run: memory-ingester --reingest
Go memory backend is the canonical implementation — Python services deleted in commit 94efa9d
Apply SurrealDB schema DDL before ingesting any observations — EnsureSchema is idempotent
SurrealDB must be version 2.x or later — HNSW and FULLTEXT ANALYZER are required features
ERROR: Engram HTTP fetch — connection refused — indicates ENGRAM_URL points to a stopped service
